Following up on our intake call — thanks again for the interest. We'd like to lock in a co-sell demo slot and a short runbook handoff so both engineering and sales teams are aligned. Proposed structure: 45 min technical walkthrough + 30 min customer Q&A / next-steps (75 minutes total).

APAC-friendly windows we can offer next week (Singapore time, SGT):
- Tue 14 Dec: 08:00–09:15 or 15:00–16:15
- Wed 15 Dec: 13:30–14:45 (preferred for us)

Please advise:
- Which date/time works for StratusOne and Microsoft?
- Who will present the SI architecture (name + role)?
- Any additional artifacts you'd like ahead of time (tenant access, sample prompts, test dataset)?

Attached: azure-co-sell-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook draft — agenda, slides owner, pre-demo checklist). I can produce a v1.1 after we confirm attendees.

Thanks — happy to adjust if timezone windows don't work.

Best,

Quick note from the engineering side — I can present the runtime/serving piece and will be available on Wed 15 Dec for either 13:00–14:15 or 13:30–14:45 SGT. Preference is 13:30–14:45 to keep to the 75-minute structure.

Couple of technical prep items we need captured in the runbook:
- Tenant access: prefer a short-lived service principal with Contributor (or a scoped set of permissions) in a test subscription rather than guest accounts. Read-only access to the target storage for sample prompts is sufficient.
- Network: if StratusOne will demo a private VPC link, include connection diagram and firewall IP allowlist.
- Test prompts & sample payloads: please share at least 3 representative prompts 48 hours before demo.
